name: Hotel Orient Elite
caption: Central Solapur hotel: rooms, vegetarian restaurant, rooftop cafe and event hall.
problems: Tall iframe fails: hero section#hero is min-height:100vh, so document height = iframe height + a constant and never converges (growth 93.6% then 48.3% at 390; 94.2% then 48.5% at 1280). Everything below the hero is cut off.
Interactive iframe traps the mouse wheel: Lenis smooth scrolling never passes wheel events to the parent page, at the top or the bottom of the framed page. Touch swipes do pass through.
41.3 MB transferred on every load (17 PNG photos 36.6 MB, one MP4 4.5 MB), none of it lazy.
A preloader covers the page from about 1.2 s to about 3 s after navigation.
Document height at 390 varies by about 50 px between loads (rotating review card).
www.hotelorientelite.co.in also answers 200 and does not redirect to the apex.
Google Maps embed (www.google.com) could not load in the build container, so the map box is empty in screenshots taken there.

name: Goodlife Fitness
caption: Premium gym in Murarji Peth, Solapur, with boxing, yoga, steam and spa.
problems: Tall iframe fails: section#top and its inner container are min-height:100vh, so document height = iframe height + a constant and never converges (growth 95.2% then 48.8% at 390; 94.7% then 48.7% at 1280). Everything below the hero is cut off and 97 scroll-reveal elements stay at opacity 0.
Very long page: 26,296 px at 390 and 22,997 px at 1280, so an interactive preview holds the scroll for a long time before the parent page takes over.
97 text elements are at opacity 0 until scrolled into view: scroll the page before taking any screenshot.
The footer and body copy call the business Goodlife Fitness Club, the same name as the other Goodlife site.
Google Maps embed (maps.google.com) could not load in the build container, so the map box is empty in screenshots taken there.
